summary: successThreshold sets the percentage of successfully updated devices required to continue a rollout (it may pause otherwise); the example fleet rolloutPolicy uses deviceSelection strategy BatchSequence with madrid, percentage and paris batches and successThreshold 95%.
questions: How do I set a success threshold for a fleet rollout?
What happens when a rollout batch falls below the threshold?

answer_card.title: BatchSequence rollout policy
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  rolloutPolicy:
    deviceSelection:
      strategy: 'BatchSequence'
      sequence:
        - selector: {matchLabels: {site: madrid}}
          limit: 1        # absolute
        - selector: {matchLabels: {site: madrid}}
          limit: 80%      # of matching devices
        - limit: 50%      # of whole fleet
        - selector: {matchLabels: {site: paris}}
        - limit: 100%
    successThreshold: 95%
```
Batches run in order; the next starts only if successes/devices ≥ threshold. A final implicit batch takes any devices left.
